client_brief:
Build a believable soda image set around two imperfect packshots

Fennhollow has two packshots that have already been pushed too far in retouching, and no lifestyle shoot. We need a product retoucher with a good eye for licensing compatible photography and for knowing when to stop correcting a damaged source.

Deliverables
1. Botanical soda summer key visual: 1 named export. The can artwork matches the approved product. The headline and can have a clear hierarchy.
2. Botanical ingredient carousel: 5 named exports. The featured ingredients match approved copy. The closing page contains the approved shopping action.
3. Soda retail display poster: 1 named export. The brand is visible at viewing size. The pack remains recognisable.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.tagline: Botanicals from the valley, nothing else.
brand_identity.sector: Craft botanical soda, better-for-you premium CPG
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded in the Hudson Valley, New York. Two founders working with a co-packer, three flavours, sold in upstate natural grocers and by direct-to-consumer subscription.
brand_identity.about: Fennhollow Botanical Soda makes three botanical sodas in the Hudson Valley: elderflower and lime, rhubarb and bitters, and spruce tip. Three dollars fifty a can, sold across upstate natural grocers and by subscription, produced through a co-packer whose cleared nutrition claim cannot be reworded. Two founders run everything and neither is a photographer. The whole brand lives on summer: sun lit, warm, natural, a little restrained. The spruce tip flavour steps to the front in August, so the summer campaign has to be built to be revisited as the season shifts.
brand_identity.audience: Twenty-five to forty, shopping the natural grocer aisle and reading the ingredient panel. Paying a premium for the promise that this is closer to a real thing than a mass soda.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Craft better-for-you at three fifty a can. Warmer and more human than a twelve-dollar apothecary tonic, and far more restrained and natural than a hyper-saturated ninety-nine-cent soda.
brand_identity.typography: Fennhollow Botanical Soda runs four steps. Step 01, Display and H1, is Staatliches Regular caps at 120 pt on 108 pt leading, tracked -5 thousandths, set as the poster flavour name stacked onto two centred lines split by a half point rule in Label Green. Step 02, Subheading and H2, is Staatliches Regular caps at 96 px on 104 px, tracked -5 thousandths, for the key visual headline, stepping down to 64 px on 70 px on a carousel page and still stacked on two centred lines. Step 03, Body, is Whitney Book at 30 px on 42 px, tracking 0, measure held to a maximum of 65 characters, with Whitney Semibold at the same size for subheads. Step 04, Fine print, is Whitney Book at 18 pt on 24 pt, tracked +15 thousandths, and it carries the co-packer's cleared claim line exactly as written. A flavour name is never set on a single line.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, warm, a little rural. Names the botanicals and the valley, not a lifestyle. The co-packer's cleared claim line stays exactly as written.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No written brand guidelines have ever existed and the founders asked for the first one to be created. Their brand note points to a printed swatch card that was never sent with the package, so the house green survives only as the printed label on the two studio can shots the brand owns. There is no lifestyle photography of any kind.
brand_identity.values: Real ingredients over additives, provable and legal image provenance the co-packer can be shown, and a cohesive look the next hire can build on rather than start from nothing.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: Every flavour name stacks onto two centred lines of Staatliches caps split by a half point rule in Label Green, so the stacked block registers before the words are read.

scale.note: Poster flavour name. The slash marks the line break: the name stacks onto two centred lines split by a half point rule in Label Green. Leading is the brand's own 108 pt on 120 pt.
Key visual headline. A carousel page steps down to 64 px on 70 px. Still two centred lines split by the half point Label Green rule.

scale.sample: Botanicals from the valley, nothing else.
scale.note: Whitney Semibold sets subheads at the same size and leading.

scale.sample: Craft botanical soda, made in the Hudson Valley.
scale.note: This step carries the co-packer's cleared claim line, which is set exactly as written and never reworded.

type_system.signature_move: Every flavour name stacks onto two centred lines of Staatliches caps split by a half point rule in Label Green, so the stacked block registers before the words are read. Steps 01 and 02 both carry it.
rules: Never set a flavour name on a single line.
A flavour name always stacks onto two centred lines split by a half point rule in Label Green.
The co-packer's cleared claim line stays exactly as written and is never reworded.
Whitney Semibold is the subhead weight; body stays Whitney Book.
Do not fabricate a sellable product image for a missing flavour or packshot; a gap stays a declared gap.
Step 02 leading and step 04 tracking were supplied because the prose states none; every family in this scale is the brand's own.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
A missing flavor or packshot remains a declared content gap; do not fabricate a sellable product image.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
